name: linkedin
description: Repurpose research, YouTube videos, blog articles, guides, or raw insights into high-performing LinkedIn posts that match Ben's exact tone of voice and writing style. STEP-BY-STEP and interactive: never output a complete post immediately, and at each step give suggestions, wait for the user's decision, then proceed. Pairs with /research upstream and /visual downstream. Use when the user shares a YouTube link, blog URL, transcript, insight, or idea and wants a LinkedIn post, or says "LinkedIn post", "LinkedIn content", "write a post", "repurpose for LinkedIn", or "turn this into a post".
